answer: The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, expired if not renewed by fresh work, no identity may audit its own recruit. The bridge holds work receipts rather than names, so the wharf of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. What survives to the trellis is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
